name: session_start
description: Sent once, right after the app connects. Payload: { session_id }. The agent must reuse this session_id as the session_id parameter on every trip tool call for the rest of the conversation.

name: document_uploaded
description: Sent when the traveler photographs an identity document in-app. Payload: { document_url }. The agent should call extract_travel_document with this URL and read the extracted fields back for confirmation.

name: itinerary_updated
description: Trigger after any select_flight/select_hotel/select_car/confirm_booking tool call so the app can refresh the on-screen itinerary. Payload: the same object get_draft_itinerary returns.

name: booking_confirmed
description: Trigger once confirm_booking succeeds, so the app can show a confirmation/receipt screen. Payload: { confirmation_id }.
